scholarships.title: TaiwanICDF Scholarship Program (International Higher Education Scholarship Program), TaiwanICDF
scholarships.official_source: International Cooperation and Development Fund (TaiwanICDF), Taiwan

existing.description: The TaiwanICDF Scholarship is the International Cooperation and Development Fund's International Higher Education Scholarship Program, which the Fund describes as offering full scholarships to outstanding students from partner countries to study in Taiwan through its TICA network of partner universities. Applicants apply to one programme at one TICA university per year through the Fund's online application system. The Fund publishes no English-proficiency test requirement of its own, and admission to the university does not by itself confer the award. The 2027 round opens on 1 December 2026 and closes on 15 March 2027.
eligibility: National of a country listed by the Fund as an eligible beneficiary country; applicants from non-beneficiary countries cannot apply
Applying to one programme at one TICA partner university; one programme per year only
Must complete the partner university's own admission procedures in addition to the Fund's application
Must submit required documents to a Republic of China embassy, consulate general or representative office in their country where necessary
Bachelor's programmes are restricted to applicants from countries that maintain diplomatic relations with Taiwan
Prior holders of a TaiwanICDF scholarship, an MOFA Taiwan Scholarship or an MOE scholarship must have graduated before the Fund's stated cut-off before re-applying
benefits: Full scholarship as stated by the Fund, with the itemised scope published separately in its Scope of Scholarship document
Study place at a TICA partner university in Taiwan
coverage: Full scholarship covering study in Taiwan at a TICA partner university and programme, as described in the Scope of Scholarship published by the Fund
Applicant must be a national of an eligible beneficiary country and apply to a TICA partner school and programme
requirements: Complete the TaiwanICDF Scholarship Online Application System in full, with accurate and complete information
Fulfil the application procedures required by the university applied to
Submit required documents to the Republic of China representative office in the applicant's country where necessary
Choose exactly one programme at one TICA partner university
application_method: Apply through the TaiwanICDF Scholarship Online Application System
Apply to the chosen TICA partner university and meet its admission requirements
Submit documents to the Republic of China embassy, consulate general or representative office where necessary
Wait for the Fund's acceptance letter, which is the only confirmation of a scholarship award
existing.selection_notes: Selection is by the Fund's holistic assessment of all positive features of an applicant rather than a single threshold or age cut-off; the Fund states there is no age limit and that every applicant is evaluated comprehensively.
existing.notes: Receiving a university admission does not mean the scholarship has been awarded; only an acceptance letter issued by the Fund confirms the award.
existing.duration: Fixed duration set by the funded programme; the Fund states the scholarship cannot be extended and any additional study must be paid for by the scholar.
existing.application_period: 1 December 2026 to 15 March 2027 for the 2027 round, as published on the Fund's Apply Now page
